outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative spatial clustering image of a single lung section with no quantification, averages, or statistical comparisons, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel B shows representative H&E images and manual annotation of a single section, with no quantitative or statistical data requiring replicate reporting.
Panel C shows representative H&E and spatial gene expression images from a single section with no averaged or statistically compared quantitative data.

replicate_statements: The nominal P and FDR values were obtained from the "GSEA Preranked" tool (from Broad Institute) using a weighted scoring scheme.
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: Panel D reports NES, FDR and P values from GSEA comparing T11b-high (S1&S2) versus T11b-low (S3) regions, and the caption describes the permutation-based statistical method, but it does not state the number or type (e.g., number of spatial spots or biological samples) of replicates/observations underlying the compared groups.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat’s FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat’s FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: Panel E reports log2 fold-change values and P values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing Tmprss11b-high versus low LUSC groups, but neither the number of spots/samples in each compared group nor the type of replicate is stated in the legend or panel.
